name: cbp-build-test-workflows
description: The hub's build-and-test workflows — development-loop (idea → planned → implemented → verified feature) and test-pipeline (the three-lane orchestrated test run with fix-loop healing) — installed as one plugin (#187 distribution pilot, cluster 2). Ships the universal dispatch closure (15 sub-skills + 7 worker agents + a bundled default pipeline config); stack-specific helpers stay provisioned per stack, and the code-review/debugging workflows come from the companion cbp-workflows and loop-engineering plugins.
